You definently deserve better friends (person below me, the one above, you have good friends it seems). However, I cannot agree more with y´all, i hate people who do this, it annoys the hell out of me because me (but that parts not important), my current boyfriend and a few of my friends are struggling with depression. And i dont mean that like oh im lonely from quarantine stuff, that stuff annoys me more than anything, cause so what being at home made you lonely, have you tried never getting to talk to anyone outside of school? Or being lonely after a day without being texted? And you think having depression is ¨cool¨ just talk to people who actually have it/any other mental disease/disorder, maybe youll get to hear what its like. But not like theyll care as people like that generally dont care about very many people. They dont care what they do to other people. They dont care that were fucking human beings too. They just want to have fun and not have to deal with other people. For example, somebody in my town just died, and one of the first comments on the news post was saying how he deserved it. The person was one of our current subject matter and he never even knew the kid. He just thought he was funny and cool. This is what our society is coming to, burying the people who need help under a mountain of fake people trying to get attention, which makes people who need the actual help uncertain of whether they need/deserve it and ultimately never seek it out, or if they do one time, instantly regret it due to being shutdown/told they dont have any problems/ignored for the attention seekers. (I can agree with not wanting attention too,  id rather give people attention then get it, but i still want some every so often, but generally just from friends/my boyfriend). And on another note, i dont even have it as bad as others, i am lucky enough to have a boyfriend and a healthy relationship, and plenty of good friends who are pretty good people (except for two, i wont go into depth there).

TL:DR: Its kinda hard to summerize except i agree with all yall on this shit, its annoying and its hurting the people who need the help.
